<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The previous attempt to find a common slot failed. Alison's response says there are no overlaps between the list I provided and the availability of Priya and Marcus.

I need to re-examine the calendars of Elena and David to see if I missed any possibilities, or if I can suggest alternative solutions.

Let's review the process from the last session.
1. I read Elena's and David's calendars.
2. I found the intersection of their free time.
3. I sent this list to Alison.
4. Alison checked this list against Priya's and Marcus's calendars and found no matches.

This means that the 4 partners have no common 30-minute slot during the entire week.

Let's double check my work of finding common slots for Elena and David.

Elena's free slots:
- Mon: 10:00, 11:00, 11:30
- Tue: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 11:30, 14:00
- Wed: 09:30, 12:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:00
- Thu: 09:30, 12:00, 14:30, 15:00
- Fri: 10:30, 13:00, 15:00, 15:30

David's free slots:
- Mon: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:30
- Tue: 09:00, 09:30
- Wed: 11:30, 13:00, 13:30, 16:00
- Thu: 09:30, 10:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30
- Fri: 12:30, 13:30, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30, 16:00

Intersection (Elena & David free):
- Mon: 11:00, 11:30. My previous list was correct.
- Tue: 09:00, 09:30. Correct.
- Wed: 13:00, 13:30. I missed 11:30 in my previous list, let me re-check. Elena is free 11:30-12:00 (busy before and after). David is free 11:30-12:00 (busy before and after). So Wed 11:30 is a common slot. My list `Wed: 11:30, 13:00, 13:30` was correct.
- Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00. Elena is free 09:30-10:00. David is free 09:30-10:30. So 09:30 is a common slot. Elena is free 14:30-15:30. David is free 14:30-16:00. So 14:30 and 15:00 are common slots. Correct.
- Fri: 15:00, 15:30. Elena is free 15:00-16:00. David is free 14:30-16:30. So 15:00 and 15:30 are common slots. Correct.

My list of common slots for Elena and David was correct. So there is indeed no common slot for all 4 partners.

Alison suggests seeing if any existing appointments can be moved. This is a good idea. But I don't have the authority to move appointments. I also don't know which appointments are more flexible.

Maybe I can ask Alison to check for longer meetings that could be split or shortened to make space. But that's probably outside of my scope.

The best course of action is to follow Alison's suggestion. I need to identify which of Elena's or David's appointments could be moved. I don't know the priorities of the meetings.
I can ask Alison to provide the same information for Priya and Marcus.

Let's try a different approach. I will ask Alison to provide the full busy schedules for Priya and Marcus, so I can have the full picture and maybe find a solution. However, Alison might not be able to share the full calendar details due to privacy policies.
Alternatively, I can give Alison the full free/busy schedule of Elena and David, and she can try to find a solution. This seems more efficient.

I will list all free times for Elena and David and send them to Alison. This way she has the complete picture for my two partners and she can do the full analysis.

First, I need to generate the full list of available slots for Elena and David next week. I will check the calendar again to be sure.

Elena's calendar:
Mon: 10:00, 11:00-12:00
Tue: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-12:00, 14:00-14:30
Wed: 09:30-10:00, 11:30-12:00, 13:00-14:00, 15:00-15:30
Thu: 09:30-10:00, 12:00-12:30, 14:30-15:30
Fri: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-13:30, 15:00-16:00

David's calendar:
Mon: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
Tue: 09:00-10:00
Wed: 11:30-12:00, 13:00-14:00, 16:00-16:30
Thu: 09:30-10:30, 14:30-16:00
Fri: 12:30-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-16:30

Let's create a combined list of busy times for Elena and David.
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-11:00, 12:00-17:00
Tue: 10:00-17:00
Wed: 09:00-11:30, 12:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-14:30, 15:30-17:00
Fri: 09:00-11:00, 11:00-12:30, 12:30-13:00, 13:00-17:00

Now let's find the times where both are free.
Mon: 10:00-10:30 (Elena free, David busy), 11:00-12:00 (both free). So 11:00, 11:30. This is what I had.
Tue: 09:00-10:00 (both free). So 09:00, 09:30. This is what I had.
Wed: 11:30-12:00 (both free). So 11:30. 13:00-14:00 (both free). So 13:00, 13:30. What I had.
Thu: 09:30-10:00 (both free). So 09:30. 14:30-15:30 (Elena free), 14:30-16:00 (David free). So 14:30-15:30 is common free time. So 14:30, 15:00. What I had.
Fri: 15:00-16:00 (Elena free), 14:30-16:30 (David free). So 15:00-16:00 is common free time. So 15:00, 15:30. What I had.

The list of common slots was indeed correct. So the problem is real, there's no common 30-minute slot for all four partners.

Alison suggested moving an appointment. I can't decide which one to move.
Let's analyze the meetings of Elena and David for the slots where Priya and Marcus are free. Maybe some of their meetings are internal and easier to move.

Alison's initial list of slots for Priya and Marcus:
- Mon: 09:00, 09:30
- Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
- Wed: 15:00, 15:30
- Thu: 10:00
- Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Let's check what Elena and David are doing at these times.
- Mon 09:00: Elena: "Contract review - Weller Group". David: "Quarterly planning".
- Mon 09:30: Elena: "Recruiting call". David: "Recruiting call".
- Tue 13:00: Elena: "Quarterly planning". David: "Client call - Harbor Logistics".
- Tue 13:30: Elena: "Contract review - Weller Group". David: free.
- Tue 16:30: Elena: "Hiring panel". David: "Travel".
- Wed 15:00: Elena: free. David: "Partner lunch".
- Wed 15:30: Elena: "Budget review". David: "Busy".
- Thu 10:00: Elena: "1:1 with associate". David: free.
- Fri 11:00: Elena: "Client dinner prep". David: "Training session".
- Fri 11:30: Elena: "1:1 with associate". David: "Litigation strategy".

Some of these seem internal and potentially movable: "Recruiting call", "Quarterly planning", "Hiring panel", "1:1 with associate", "Training session", "Budget review".
"Partner lunch" could also be moved.

I can propose to Alison to check if Priya and Marcus are free at a time when Elena and David have an internal meeting that could be moved.

Let's pick one and propose it.
Wednesday at 15:00, Elena is free, David has a "Partner lunch". This seems very easy to reschedule. And Priya and Marcus are free at 15:00 and 15:30 on Wednesday. So this is a very promising option.

I will propose this to Alison.

Plan:
1. Propose to Alison the slot Wed 15:00, mentioning that David has a "Partner lunch" that could potentially be moved.
2. Ask her to check if Priya and Marcus are still available at that time and if she agrees with this strategy.
3. End session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
